extractions.description: The paper proposes feature conformal prediction, extending conformal prediction to semantic feature spaces. It introduces a new non-conformity score and methods for band estimation and detection. The approach demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet classification and Cityscapes image segmentation.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper focuses on improving machine learning techniques, it does not directly address or substantially contribute to Sustainable Development goals.
